mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, background_inventory_id, background_asset_key, background_asset_url, max_item_count, layout_version, created_at, updated_at FROM mini_room WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mini_room ( user_id, background_asset_key, background_asset_url, max_item_count, layout_version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{backgroundAssetKey}, #{backgroundAssetUrl}, 50, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE mini_room SET background_inventory_id = #{backgroundInventoryId}, background_asset_key = #{backgroundAssetKey}, background_asset_url = #{backgroundAssetUrl}, layout_version = layout_version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT mri.id AS room_item_id, mri.user_inventory_id, i.item_id, i.category, i.name, i.description, i.asset_key, i.asset_url, i.asset_width, i.asset_height, i.placement_type, mri.pos_x, mri.pos_y, mri.rotation, mri.flipped, mri.scale, mri.sort_order, mri.locked FROM mini_room_item mri JOIN user_inventory ui ON ui.id = mri.user_inventory_id JOIN item i ON i.item_id = ui.item_id WHERE mri.mini_room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY mri.sort_order ASC, mri.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mini_room_item ( mini_room_id, user_inventory_id, pos_x, pos_y, rotation, flipped, scale, sort_order, locked, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{miniRoomId}, #{userInventoryId}, #{posX}, #{posY}, #{rotation}, #{flipped}, #{scale}, #{sortOrder}, #{locked}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, avatar_inventory_id, pos_x, pos_y, scale, flipped, created_at, updated_at FROM avatar WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO avatar ( user_id, avatar_inventory_id, pos_x, pos_y, scale, flipped, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{avatarInventoryId}, #{posX}, #{posY}, #{scale}, #{flipped}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE avatar SET avatar_inventory_id = #{avatarInventoryId}, pos_x = #{posX}, pos_y = #{posY}, scale = #{scale}, flipped = #{flipped}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
